name: Omex CivServ Rubber-Sole Oxford
description: A lace-up oxford in matte black synthetic leather with a reinforced rubber sole rated for wet concrete and transit platform grating. The toe cap is slightly squared — a relic of a design template that hasn't been updated in fifteen years. Comfortable after the first brutal week of break-in.
functionality: Slip-resistant sole, moisture-sealed seams, arch support insert included.
what_it_says: You bought functional over fashionable and you've made peace with that.
story_hooks: The rubber sole compound contains a passive RFID tag that logs building entry data — most wearers don't know.
A pair resoled four times by the same cobbler on Level 2 Circuit; the uppers are original, the sole is something else entirely.
